sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12:1
items.html: The Parsa is not for the matter of the world of Nekudim itself, which is the world of Atzilut, but for the need of the world of Beria beneath it: It has already been explained above that the matter of the Parsa is the secret of the screen that concludes the Partzuf SAG, similar to the toes of its feet beforehand. However, there is a great correction in it, which the Zohar calls “that which draws from above and gives below,” as above in the words of the ARI. And this is because it is the discernment of a doubled screen, of two phases: of phase two and of phase four together. Therefore the matter of the breaching of the Parsa applies to it at the time when Beria needs to receive the light from Atzilut. And the meaning of a breach is the annulment of the boundary of the conclusion that is in it, and the expansion of the lights of SAG below the Parsa. And it is only an annulment for the hour, and afterwards it closes again, so that it resembles an opening that opens and shuts. And the matter depends upon the descent of phase four of the Parsa out of phase two of the Parsa. For at the time when the two phases are joined and pressed tightly to one another, then the Parsa is shut, like the screen that stands at the toes of the feet, since there is no expansion whatsoever of the Partzuf after the conclusion of the toes of its feet. But at the time when phase four leaves the Parsa and descends to the place of the toes of the feet of the Partzuf, as it was beforehand, then the force of the conclusion of the Parsa is annulled — and this is called the Parsa having been breached — and the lights pass from there downward to the world of Beria. And this is the intention of the Zohar, that it draws from above and gives below. And it will be explained further below.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12:2
items.html: A screen and a Parsa between Beria and Atzilut. For by the force of the Parsa that was corrected here beneath the Partzuf SAG of AK, the boundary of the world of Nekudim was fixed upon the discernment of its Tabur; and upon this Tabur of Nekudim that same Parsa which is between Atzilut and Beria was made, as will be written well below. And this is what he hints (18), that from this one should understand the Parsa that is between Atzilut and Beria, for they are one and the same matter.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12:3
items.html:
Atzilut, to what is above it no actual screen is needed, but only a remoteness of place alone: That is to say, that even though the matter of the conclusion of the feet of SAG upon the Parsa comes by reason of the ascent of the lights that are below the Tabur as MAN [female waters] to the Nikvey Einayim — for which reason the AHP of the Rosh [head] went outside the Rosh, and Bina and ZA and Malchut of the ten Sefirot of the conclusion went outside the Guf [body] of Atzilut, as above, page 401, the passage beginning “Parsa,” study it there — and it would therefore seem at first sight that the Parsa comes for the correction of the Atzilut of the lights of Nekudim, for the reason that they are emanated from the lights of the Einayim. He therefore says that it is indeed true that the matter of the conclusion itself of the Partzuf SAG upon the Parsa comes with the measure of Atzilut that is in the Nikvey Einayim. However, this is still not called a screen and a Parsa, (21) but only a remoteness of place alone; for beforehand the conclusion of the Partzuf SAG was level with the feet of the inner AK, and now, by reason of the coupling that was raised into the light of the Einayim, the conclusion of the Partzuf was raised to the place of the Tabur, and this new boundary was called only a remoteness of place alone. However, the matter of the Parsa is another thing, which is added on top of the remoteness from the Tabur upward, and it is for the need of Beria, as above; for there is in the Parsa a special correction, by reason of which the lights of Atzilut pass to Beria.
13) Renewed lights and additional worlds come about only through the restriction of light: For no renewal is made in the worlds except by reason of a renewal of vessels; but in the light there is never any change whatsoever, and just as it shines at the head of the line, so the light shines at the end of Assiya. And the matter of the coming into being of the vessels is as the ARI writes above, Part 4, Chapter 1, item 9: “For the cause of the expansion of the light and its subsequent departure brought about the making of the existence of a vessel.” Thus the restriction and the departure of the light are the very existence of the vessel. And the reason for this has already been brought at length in Part 4, in the Inner Observation, item 58.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12:4
items.html: The restriction of Ein Sof in order to bring out AK. This has been explained in the Inner Observation, Part 4, page 268, item 63, study it there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:12:5
items.html:
Close to the annulment of the kings. This has been explained above, page 237, item 7, and in the Inner Light there, item 400. And it has already been explained on page 398, the passage beginning “restriction,” the matter of the likeness between the restriction of Ein Sof in order to bring out AK — which is the secret of the first line that Ein Sof shone into the place of the restriction — and the second restriction, which is the restriction of NHY of AK: that both of them are the discernment of the conclusion and of the cessation for the lights of Atzilut. But the difference is this, that the point of cessation that was made by the first restriction, for the point of the conclusion of the feet of the Partzuf AK, was in this world, since the feet of AK conclude in this world, in the secret of the verse “And His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives.” And the second restriction made the place of the conclusion and the cessation of the Atzilut of SAG, and this new point of cessation is called Parsa. And it is likewise the conclusion of the feet of all the Partzufim of Atzilut that come after the Partzuf SAG, since every force that is renewed in the upper one necessarily governs also those that are lower than it. And it is the place of the cut and of the cessation between the world of Atzilut and the three worlds BYA. 14) And their ascent there was of benefit for the need of Mayin Nukvin, and by this you will understand, etc. AVI, which divided into two: The matter of MAN [female waters] has already been explained above, page 396, the passage beginning “MA and BON.”
Study it there well, and there is no need to repeat the words. And the matter of AVI, which divided into two, has already been explained on page 397, the passage beginning “AVI to YESHSUT.” Study it there well. See there also the passage beginning “AVI couple,” for it is impossible to repeat all of this. And there you will find that two couplings were made for the need of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim. The first was through the ascent of the NHY of AK, which are included of phase four and of phase two together, as MAN to the Taamim [tastes] of SAG, and from there to the Nikvey Einayim of the Rosh of SAG. This caused there the division of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of SAG into two discernments, Rosh [head] and Guf [body]: GE became a Rosh, and the AHP went outside, in the discernment of a Guf, as was written above, page 391, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “hairs,” and page 392, the passage beginning “in which are included.” Study it there well. For that division into Galgalta and Einayim and AHP was not made in the very Rosh of SAG, but in the discernment of the ten Sefirot of the hairs. Study it there. However, the Rosh of SAG cannot bestow upon the one below it except through this Partzuf of the hairs, since every force that has been renewed in the upper one necessarily governs the one below it, as is known. Therefore all the lights that are bestowed upon the lower ones come out through the coupling that is made in the Nikvey Einayim and receive from the discernment of the AHP of the hairs, and they must divide into GE and AHP, like the ten Sefirot of the hairs.
And as for the level that came out through the ascent of MAN to the Nikvey Einayim, it has already been explained there that it is only the level of ZA and lacks GAR [first three]. And it is called YESHSUT, because the phase two of clothing remained there, as in the preceding Partzufim. And it divides into two discernments: GE for the discernment of a Rosh, and AHP for the discernment of a Guf. And their place is from the Chazeh of SAG downward, where the Rosh, which is the discernment of GE, expands from the Chazeh to the Tabur of SAG, and it alone is called by the name YESHSUT; and the AHP expands from the Tabur downward, and they are the GAR of Nekudim.
And this is what he says: “After the restriction and the Parsa, the lights are found there in very great number in the place of the Chazeh, and their ascent there was of benefit for the need of MAN.” That is to say, after YESHSUT came out from the Nikvey Einayim and descended and expanded from the place of the Chazeh to the Tabur, as above, (22) the lights there in the place of the Chazeh had multiplied. And you already know that the Parsa is included of the two phases, phase four and phase two, as was written above (page 403, the passage beginning “the Parsa.” Study it there well). And it was explained there that at times phase four descends out of the Parsa, and then the Parsa is breached and the boundary is annulled. And behold, the expansion of YESHSUT from the place of the Chazeh to the Tabur brought about the descent of phase four out of the Parsa; for it became MAN for the Taamim of SAG, and then the inner AB that is inside the Rosh of the Taamim of SAG (as above, page 389, the passage beginning “and the AB,” study it there) coupled with the Rosh of SAG that is called AHP, since the light of the Ozen [ear] is clothed in the Galgalta of SAG (as above, page 390, the passage beginning “and its SAG”), study it there. And through this coupling of AB and SAG, the bottom Hey descended once more from the Nikvey Einayim of SAG to the place of the Peh [mouth], that is, to the Malchut of the Rosh, as it was at first. And then the coupling was made in the Peh of the Rosh upon the phase four that is there, and a new level came out, up to Keter, from the Peh of the Rosh of SAG upward. And from there this new light descended to YESHSUT that is in the place of the Chazeh, and it also brought down the phase four that is in the discernment of its own Nikvey Einayim, which is in the place of the Tabur; it brought her down to the place of the Peh, which is the Malchut of the Rosh at the conclusion of the GAR of Nekudim. And because of this the GAR of Nekudim, which in their source are the AHP of YESHSUT, joined with YESHSUT that is at the Chazeh, which is their GE, and together they became the discernment of the ten Sefirot of a single Rosh at the level of Keter; for now the coupling was made upon the phase four that had descended to the Malchut at the conclusion of the GAR of Nekudim. And this is the secret of the new light that breaches the Parsa, which the ARI brings afterwards.
And behold, the two couplings that were for the need of Nekudim have now been well explained: that from the first coupling only the discernment of the Katnut [smallness] of Nekudim came out, that is, only the level of ZA, lacking GAR. And this coupling was made in the Nikvey Einayim, which brought the AHP of the Rosh of SAG out into the discernment of a Guf. And in this same way there came out, in the level that emerged from there, which is called YESHSUT, likewise two discernments, Rosh and Guf, upon the discernment of its own Nikvey Einayim. For from the Nikvey Einayim upward it is called YESHSUT, and the point of the Tabur is the discernment of these Nikvey Einayim, where YESHSUT concludes. And from the Nikvey Einayim downward, which is from the Tabur downward, the Ozen, Hotem, and Peh of YESHSUT expanded, and they are the GAR of Nekudim. And know that even though the new light that came out from this first coupling lacks GAR, it is nevertheless their very self and the root of the light of Nekudim.
And the second coupling, which was made for the need of Nekudim, drew the GAR and the Mochin to them. And this coupling was made through two Partzufim, AB and SAG, as above. And through this coupling the separation that had come about because of the restriction of NHY and their ascent to the Nikvey Einayim was joined once more — that is, the GE and the AHP that had parted from one another into a Rosh and a Guf; for through their coupling of AB and SAG they joined again and became once more the ten Sefirot of a single Rosh. For they brought the bottom Hey down from the Nikvey Einayim to the place of the Peh as at first, and then the Parsa was breached, the Parsa being the place of the new conclusion that was made for SAG in the place of the Hochma of the ten Sefirot that conclude, which is the source of the Tabur, as was written above (page 403, the passage beginning “the Parsa,” study it there). And now this new boundary was annulled; for just as phase four descended from the Nikvey Einayim to the place of the Peh in the Rosh of SAG, so phase four descended from the place of the Tabur and the Parsa to the place of the conclusion of the feet of AK, as at first.
